item.title: Local roundup: MacKenzie wins CCAA silver; Sting alum Ritchie stars
item.description: Camlachie’s Layla MacKenzie won silver with the Fanshawe Falcons at the CCAA women’s basketball championship in Montreal.

item.title: Water, sewer rate changes funding more Sarnia road reconstruction
item.description: Along with ongoing work to separate combined sanitary and storm sewers, Sarnia is investing in more water main upgrades this year.

item.title: Sarnia pump station upgrade planned to help with flooding risk
item.description: Boosting another Sarnia pump station's capacity 50 per cent is the city's final planned move to help guard a flood-prone neighbourhood.

item.title: Sarnia pipeline leak location determined, says Sun-Canadian
item.description: The location of a leak in a Sun-Canadian pipeline that led to a hydrocarbon spill detected March 11 in Sarnia has been determined.

item.title: Lambton County Library One Seed program returns Saturday
item.description: Free rainbow Swiss chard seeds will be available as of Saturday at Lambton County Library branches as its One Seed program sprouts again

item.title: Letter: 'Magnificent mural' brightens Sarnia City Hall foyer
item.description: We believe that the majority of Sarnians share our appreciation for the magnificent mural that now brightens the foyer of our City Hall.

item.title: Sarnia Sting hungry for turnaround after brutal three-year stretch
item.description: The Sarnia Sting’s brain trust has its work cut out for it this off-season.

item.title: Bar patrons threatened, one charged: Sarnia police
item.description: A Sarnia resident faces charges after a man with a knife and baseball bat reportedly threatened patrons of a Devine Street bar, city police say.
